annotation.title_clean: ISO 7856:2025 Intelligent transport systems — Remote support for low speed automated driving systems (RS-LSADS) — Performance requirements, system requirements and performance test procedures
annotation.title_en: ISO 7856:2025 Intelligent transport systems — Remote support for low speed automated driving systems (RS-LSADS) — Performance requirements, system requirements and performance test procedures
annotation.venue: ISO Online Browsing Platform / ISO store
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO 7856:2025, an international standard specifying performance requirements, system requirements and test procedures for remote support (monitoring, assistance, limited remote driving) of Level 4 low-speed automated driving systems on predefined routes, for passenger and logistics services.
key_provisions_or_claims: Covers remote monitoring, remote assistance and limited remote driving for Level 4 low-speed automated driving systems
Specifies performance requirements, system requirements and test procedures
Defines data exchanged between vehicles and the remote support facility, excluding communication protocols
Excludes strategic functions and daily startup or shutdown
